purpose: Produce bounded opaque role candidates for VDD, VCM, and load binding without returning OA names, values, raw content, or paths.

candidate_commitment.meaning: opaque commitment bound to this exact source fingerprint; not proof of semantic role

VDD.candidates: bounded array of opaque candidate objects

VCM.candidates: bounded array of opaque candidate objects

load_condition.candidates: bounded array of opaque candidate objects

sensitive_output_denylist: actual master library, cell, or view names
PDK names beyond the fixed public target identity or PDK content
fail_closed_conditions: plan hash or installation identity mismatch
target identity or source fingerprint mismatch
structure other than 35 instances, 14 nets, and 8 terminals
active, stale, ambiguous, panic, or recovery blocker
symlink, unsupported object, unreadable target, or resource bound exceeded
master or property slot outside the exact internal allowlist
terminal count other than two for a candidate
zero or multiple property slots for a candidate
attempt to read or emit a property value
attempt to emit an OA name, raw object, path, or PDK content
OA open mode other than r, close failure, save callback, or write transaction
timeout, concurrent invocation, oversized output, or unbounded error
attempt to turn a candidate or unique count into an approved role binding
any simulation, netlisting, deployment, MCP exposure, mutation, cleanup, or retry
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: this plan and bound collector plan hashes are verified before future implementation
AC-02: the command accepts zero arguments, is operator-only, and is absent from the MCP surface
AC-03: only MyDesignLib/Differential_Amplifier_TB2/schematic at the required source fingerprint can be opened
AC-04: source structure must be exactly 35 instances, 14 nets, and 8 terminals
AC-05: no caller path, design identifier, property name, property value, shell text, or SKILL text exists
AC-06: the internal master classification map is exact and closed; every other master is a blocked candidate
AC-07: property access is limited to presence and type classification of exact internal slots; values are never read or emitted
AC-08: OA opens only in mode r and closes without save on every success and failure path
AC-09: instances, nets, terminals, properties, candidates, logs, output, time, and concurrency obey the fixed bounds
AC-10: source and every protected fingerprint plus lock state are identical before and after
AC-11: active or ambiguous locks and panic/recovery artifacts block without deletion, unlock, rename, repair, or retry
AC-12: each candidate exposes only commitment hash, allowlisted master class, connection-role enum, property-slot class, terminal count two, and false semantic confirmation
AC-13: actual instance, net, terminal, property, and master names and all values remain absent from stdout, stderr, logs, artifacts, and repository evidence
AC-14: each role reports at most 16 candidates and a bounded ambiguity enum; zero, multiple, or unsupported candidates remain unresolved
AC-15: a unique candidate is not automatically an approved role binding and no semantic role is inferred
AC-16: selector commitments are domain-separated and bound to the exact source fingerprint; raw canonical tuples are never emitted
AC-17: output validates against the fixed schema and is at most 16384 bytes with bounded blocker enums

AC-18: negative tests cover arguments, injection, Unicode/confusables, symlinks, locks, source drift, topology drift, unsupported masters/slots, candidate overflow, value-read attempts, name disclosure, fingerprint drift, timeout, and redaction
AC-19: implementation, deployment, and one fixed execution each require later explicit plan-hash-bound authority; plan approval alone authorizes none
AC-20: success produces candidate evidence only; failure performs no fallback, cleanup, retry, binding, simulation, mutation, merge, or WP-15 work
next_gate: User reviews this plan. A later run may implement and locally test the repository-side fixed discovery only if explicitly authorized against the final plan hash; deployment and execution remain separately prohibited until another approval.
